outcome: Effectiveness of antibiotic prophylaxis (implied reduced post-operative complications)
cohort: The study included 200 women undergoing elective caesarean section, randomly divided into two groups.
finding: This study found that single dose antibiotic prophylaxis is as effective as conventional multi dose antibiotic therapy for women undergoing elective caesarean section, also being cost-effective and reducing antibiotic resistance, patient side effects, and nursing staff workload.
